source: World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH / WAHIS) & National Disease Surveillance
surveillance_species: Panthera tigris (Bengal Tiger, Siberian Tiger, Indochinese Tiger)

official_disease_events.location: Pilibhit & Dudhwa Tiger Reserves, Uttar Pradesh, India
official_disease_events.clinical_manifestation: Myoclonus (muscle twitching), respiratory distress, abnormal fearlessness toward humans, ataxia
official_disease_events.control_measures: Buffer zone domestic dog vaccination, quarantine of stray canines, contact tracking

official_disease_events.location: Mudumalai Tiger Reserve, Tamil Nadu, India
official_disease_events.clinical_manifestation: Progressive emaciation, pulmonary granulomas, chronic coughing, lethargy
official_disease_events.control_measures: Fringe livestock tuberculin testing, carcass safe incineration, grazing restrictions in core buffer

official_disease_events.clinical_manifestation: Intermittent high fever, severe anemia, subcutaneous edema, bilateral corneal opacity
official_disease_events.control_measures: Vector fly control around waterholes, prophylactic diminazene diaceturate in monitored individuals

official_disease_events.location: Captive and Rescue Centers / Bordering Wild Sanctuaries
official_disease_events.clinical_manifestation: Hyperacute severe hemorrhagic pneumonia, neurologic signs, acute recumbency
official_disease_events.control_measures: Raw poultry feeding ban, migratory waterbird carcass containment, biosecurity cordons

official_disease_events.clinical_manifestation: Hyper-aggression, unprovoked attacks, hyper-salivation, hydrophobia, paralysis
official_disease_events.control_measures: Rapid response darting team notification, post-exposure human prophylaxis, buffer canine vaccination

official_disease_events.clinical_manifestation: Severe bloody diarrhea, acute dehydration, profound leukopenia, high cub mortality
official_disease_events.control_measures: Disinfection of water troughs, feral feline deterrents
